name: Emoza Starter Sites
author: Emoza

sections.description:
Emoza Starter Sites is the companion demo importer for the Emoza and Emoza WooCommerce themes. It lets you launch a beautiful, ready-to-use online store or website in minutes with complete starter templates, widgets, customizer settings, and sample products.

Whether you are building a beauty & cosmetics boutique, fashion store, organic wellness shop, or modern lifestyle brand, Emoza Starter Sites gets your site ready with zero hassle.

Key Features

  • 1-Click Demo Import: Import complete pages, posts, navigation menus, widgets, and customizer styling in seconds.
  • WooCommerce Ready: Includes pre-configured e-commerce templates with sample products and shop layouts.
  • Builder Flexibility: Fully compatible with both Elementor and the native WordPress Block Editor (Gutenberg).
  • Non-Destructive: Preview templates before importing, and easily remove or reset demo content whenever you want.
  • Lightweight & Fast: Runs exclusively in the WordPress admin during import, leaving zero bloat on your live site.

How It Works

  1. Install and activate the Emoza theme and Emoza Starter Sites plugin.
  2. In your WordPress dashboard, navigate to Appearance > Starter Sites.
  3. Choose your starter template, pick your preferred builder (Elementor or Gutenberg), and click Import.
sections.installation:
1. In your WordPress admin, go to Plugins > Add New.
  2. Search for Emoza Starter Sites.
  3. Click Install Now, then Activate.
  4. Navigate to Appearance > Starter Sites to browse and import demo templates.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require the Emoza theme?

Yes. Emoza Starter Sites is specifically engineered to import templates, typography, and styling configurations designed for the Emoza and Emoza WooCommerce themes.

Which page builders can I use?

The plugin supports both Elementor and the native WordPress Block Editor (Gutenberg) using Stackable blocks. You can select your preferred builder during import.

Will importing a demo overwrite my existing content?

The importer adds new pages, posts, menus, and products without deleting your existing content. However, it will update your Customizer options (colors, typography) and widget areas to match the demo. For best results, we recommend importing on a fresh WordPress installation.

Can I remove the imported demo content?

Yes. The plugin includes a built-in option to remove or reset imported demo content if you want to try another template.

Can I deactivate the plugin after importing?

Yes. Once your site is imported and set up, you can safely deactivate the plugin. Your imported pages, products, and settings will remain fully intact.
sections.changelog:
1.0.2

  • Compatibility: Tested and fully stabilized for WordPress 7.1 and PHP 8.0, 8.1, 8.2, and 8.3.
  • Security: Strengthened capability checks and nonce verifications across all AJAX endpoints.
  • Fix: Resolved undefined variable warning during the finish-import step.
  • Fix: Added type safety checks to prevent TypeErrors and deprecation warnings in modern PHP environments.
  • Standards: Achieved full compliance with WordPress Coding Standards (WPCS).
  • Cleanup: Fixed corrupted encoding characters and removed global scope pollution.

1.0.1

  • Elementor New Demo Added – for “product fivar” demo.
  • Stackable plugin suggestion during Gutenberg demo import.
  • Enhanced demo removal functionality.

1.0.0

  • New starter sites added for Emoza.
